prompt_messages.content: Extract only grounded concepts and bridging relations from the latest Target response. Every new concept or edge supporting_span must be an exact contiguous substring of that response. Do not infer persona labels or use hidden information. Valid relation_type values are: part-of, member-of, instrument, theme, cause-of, in, temporal. Extract at most six concepts and four edges; prefer fewer high-value items. Return one compact JSON object only.
